fields.PRODUCT NAME: Handcrafted Wooden Tortoise – Rajasthani Art Décor
fields.DESCRIPTION: Adorn your space with this exquisite hand-carved wooden tortoise, a symbol of longevity, stability, and prosperity in Indian tradition. Carefully crafted by skilled Rajasthani artisans, the piece showcases intricate carving on its shell, highlighting the timeless beauty of traditional craftsmanship. The tortoise holds special significance in Vastu Shastra and Feng Shui, believed to bring balance, protection, and positive energy into the home. Its compact size makes it perfect for placing on a desk, showcase, or pooja space.
